description: Tomb Gamma, a Cold War bunker under Montana. At six o'clock the man behind ENTROPY's plan releases every weakness SAFETYNET ever catalogued to every city at once. Raid the bunker with Task Force Null, take his systems one host at a time, find the sleeper on your own team, and decide at his console what happens to the database, and to him.
_vm_wire: VM-WIRE: secgen_scenario points at the SecGen draft (three targets — bunker_monitor, release_host, core_host — plus the Kali attack_vm). The box is not built yet; flag values are generated at build (F9: confirm the three hostnames, that each station takes the right flag, and that root login over SSH is refused on the release and core hosts). lab_sheet_url is added with the lab sheet, the last step.
title: Mission 10: Full Disclosure
subtitle: Season Finale
location: Tomb Gamma, a converted Cold War bunker, Lewis and Clark County, Montana

secgen.scenario: m10_full_disclosure (Break Escape SAFETYNET: Mission 10 — Full Disclosure VMs)
vulnerabilities: Maltrail unauthenticated command injection in the monitoring platform's login handler (security monitoring host foothold)
Staging schedule held in the monitoring platform's threat-data store (monitoring host, second flag)
Privileged container (Docker) escape to the host beneath it (release host)
Chroot jail escape to the host beneath it (core host)
Network mapping and service fingerprinting across the bunker network
secgen.integrationMethod: Three targets, four flag stations, one flag each: the gate terminal takes the monitoring host's foothold, the release console its staging schedule, the sealed section's hatch the release host, the core host terminal the core host; each flag's reward sets a story global that opens the bunker's doors

new: A raid team that moves room by room with you, one of whom is the sleeper
Naming the sleeper on the line or face to face, with a cost for a wrong name
A three-exchange argument whose landed points decide how the end can go
Three database choices: secure, coordinated disclosure, or destroy both copies
Six endings, including a clearly signposted way to join ENTROPY
